channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Midlife exercise may benefit brain health decades later
item.description: Physical activity and healthy blood sugar in midlife could slow cognitive decline, with exercise showing particular benefits.

item.title: New Ice Age amphibian discovered in La Brea Tar Pits fossils
item.description: Researchers identified a new extinct amphibian species, Spea labreae, from fossil collections at Los Angeles' La Brea Tar Pits.

item.title: Black hole tears apart a massive star, leaving a mysterious survivor
item.description: Astronomers observed a black hole shredding a huge star, producing an extremely powerful explosion. The event may have left behind an unexpected remnant.

item.title: Study explains why walking becomes more difficult as we age
item.description: With age, the body prioritizes stability over walking efficiency. Older adults stiffen their ankles more with each step, which may reduce energy efficiency.
